WITH expense_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        e.expense_id,
        e.cost,
        m.phone AS contact_number
    FROM "expense" e
    JOIN member m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
),
avg_cost AS (
    SELECT AVG(cost) AS avg_cost
    FROM expense_stats
),
members_with_expenditure AS (
    SELECT 
        es.contact_number,
        es.cost
    FROM expense_stats es
    WHERE es.cost > (SELECT avg_cost FROM avg_cost)
)

    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.phone

WITH 
-- Helper to get the fastest lap speed for a specific race and driver (excluding the current one)
AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS fastestLapSpeed,
        COALESCE(r.milliseconds, 0) AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.year = 853 AND r.circuitId = 853
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM races r2 
          WHERE r2.year = r.year AND r2.circuitId = r.circuitId 
            AND r2.raceId = r.raceId 
            AND r2.driverId != r.driverId
      )
),
-- Helper to get the fastest lap speed for the next race (raceId + 1) for the same driver
AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS fastestLapSpeed,
        COALESCE(r.milliseconds, 0) AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.year = 854 AND r.circuitId = 853
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM races r2 
          WHERE r2.year = r.year AND r2.circuitId = r.circuitId 
            AND r2.raceId = r.raceId + 1 
            AND r2.driverId != r.driverId
      )
)

        ELSE 0
    END AS percentage_faster
FROM (
    SELECT 
        fastestLapSpeed AS base_speed,
        ms FROM pms
    UNION ALL

        fastestLapSpeed AS base_speed,
